images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one cohesive vehicle art-direction board for the child-friendly 3D monstertruck browser game DUST RUSH. This is a concept reference, not a screenshot.
Primary request: Design a coherent family of FOUR genuinely different gorgeous monster trucks, displayed as four separate complete vehicles in a clean 2 by 2 studio board. Same front-three-quarter camera angle and scale in all cells, generous whitespace, all four wheels fully in frame. All share the turquoise enamel, orange accents, dark graphite chassis, orange coil-over suspension and giant deeply treaded dark rubber tires of this visual design.
The four bodies: top left a muscular rounded racing PICKUP with an aggressive rounded hood, hood scoop, tubular bull bar, short bed and rear wing with a short bed; top right a low open tubular dune BUGGY with a visible roll cage and smaller streamlined body panels; bottom left a playful rounded cab-over delivery VAN, recognizably a van with a continuous roof and short nose, not an SUV; bottom right a rounded retro HOT ROD with narrow hood, small curved cabin, exposed polished V8 blower and rounded rear body.
Style: premium stylized 3D racing-game art, appealing sophisticated vehicle design, physical well-connected mechanics, rounded manufactured surfaces and readable silhouettes. Slightly simplify the microdetail of this visual design so these are achievable real-time game models; preserve the chunky sculpted fenders, real tire profiles and strong material separation. Clean chrome accents, subtle controlled wear, glossy paint and satin rubber, no cheap box-shaped blockouts.
Lighting/background: warm off-white studio background, neutral soft daylight and tidy grounded shadows, bright legible body shapes.
Text: no labels, no words, no numbers, no logos.
Constraints: four wheels per vehicle, front and rear axle connections plausible, no floating components, no fifth wheel, no people, no faces on vehicles, no weapons, no cut-off tires, no white patches on rubber. Consistent chassis proportions across the family, differing BODY SHAPES must be obvious even at thumbnail size.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one coherent mechanical parts catalogue art-direction board for a premium stylized monstertruck game configurator for children.
Primary request: A beautiful clean 3 by 3 grid of NINE isolated monstertruck COMPONENTS. These are clearly separated individual parts, NEVER complete vehicles. Empty warm off-white studio background and generous padding. No panel borders, no words, no numbers, no logos.
ROW 1: three different complete WHEEL assemblies with orange beadlock rims, black hubs, dark matte rubber and chunky tread, all shown in the same three-quarter side view: first classic deep chevron monstertruck tire, second broad mud tire with staggered thick block tread, third an extra-wide extra-large balloon monster tire with massive chevron lugs. All have authentic manufactured construction and a clean readable silhouette; no white marks on tires.
ROW 2: three isolated SUSPENSION coil-over assemblies, each with orange spring around a dark graphite damper and steel mounting eyes; short, medium and long travel respectively. They must look like suspension parts, NOT wheels or whole vehicles.
ROW 3: three clearly distinct isolated ENGINE assemblies, each complete: compact V8 engine with twin orange valve covers and round air filter; muscular V8 with a polished Roots supercharger and 3-port intake scoop; compact electric drive unit with graphite motor casing, orange high-voltage cables and turquoise fins. Simple readable shapes with plausible connected parts. No loose clutter or disconnected plumbing.
Style: premium game-ready stylized 3D product renders, rounded manufactured forms, robust proportions and modest mechanical detail that can actually be modeled for a real-time browser game. Strong cohesive material separation: turquoise enamel accents, burnt orange, brushed metal, dark graphite, matte black rubber. Soft studio keylight and grounded subtle shadows. Consistent camera direction, comparable visual size per cell, every component completely in frame. No photoreal noise, no cheap cubes, no explosion diagrams, no scenery. This is concept design, not a screenshot.
images.editPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: polished mechanical parts catalogue concept board.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Preserve all nine separate component designs, their camera angles, colors, positions and 3 by 3 grid arrangement exactly.
Change ONLY the background and edge cleanup: replace the transparent/black-looking background with a completely OPAQUE continuous warm off-white studio backdrop, matching the sophisticated product presentation. Remove ALL accidental red and yellow edge fringes and speckled halos around tires, springs, motors and shadows. Clean smooth anti-aliased edges and soft neutral gray grounded shadows. Preserve orange springs and orange painted metal as orange, the tires dark charcoal and the actual machinery unchanged. No labels, no text, no additional objects. The whole image must be opaque with no transparency or cutout artifacts.

images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a cohesive 3 by 3 catalogue board of game-world assets for DUST RUSH, a polished kid-friendly monstertruck game.
Design NINE separate isolated props, one in each evenly spaced cell, fully visible and in consistent three-quarter perspective:
Row one: sturdy wooden shipping crate with individual planks, steel corner brackets and diagonal braces; a slightly dented burnt-orange oil drum with rolled steel rims, two reinforcing ribs and closed lid; an orange traffic cone with a broad dark rubber base and cream reflective band.
Row two: a stack of three dark deeply treaded used tires, slightly uneven; a compact turquoise junkyard sedan with faded paint, dark intact windows and small wheels, suitable to drive over; the same car visibly crushed flat through its roof, dents and wrinkled metal but no shards or dangerous spikes.
Row three: a weathered turquoise and cream concrete Jersey safety barrier with angled base and mounting holes; a modular broad curved steel jump ramp with orange edge trim, grippy steel deck and visible triangulated support frame; a compact golden-dirt tabletop jump mound with sculpted curved approach and worn tire tracks.
Style: sophisticated stylized-realistic 3D vehicle-game assets with rounded manufactured edges, readable silhouettes, strong physical material separation, tasteful subtle wear, brushed metal, wood grain, dusty rubber, believable dirt. Match glossy turquoise and orange monstertruck concepts; not low-poly cubes, not flat illustration. Optimize design complexity for an achievable real-time game asset.
Presentation: ALL objects completely framed, separated with generous padding on one fully OPAQUE warm ivory studio background. Soft neutral daylight and short gray grounded shadows. NO transparency. NO colored edge halos. No words, no labels, no numbers, no brand logos, no people, no vehicles other than the two small crushable cars.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: ONE coherent game environment art-direction triptych for DUST RUSH, a child-friendly monstertruck game.
Composition: three wide horizontal panels stacked vertically in one tall image. No UI or text. Clearly readable layouts, all in the same premium stylized-realistic 3D material language, rounded forms, rich warm light, turquoise/orange accents, dusty warm sandstone and dark graphite metal. Design toward practical real-time models, not fantasy architecture.
Top panel RACING: a joyful broad off-road circuit in a sunny desert canyon, ground-level slightly elevated three-quarter establishing view. Grippy compacted dirt track with subtle tire grooves, turquoise and ivory concrete safety barriers, orange track cones, rounded weathered layered sandstone mesas, clusters of smooth sculpted rocks and ribbed green cacti. A practical metal truss finish arch with a hanging black-and-ivory checkered tear-through ribbon, small track signs with pictograms only. The road is generously wide and the route immediately obvious.
Middle panel ARENA: a stadium monstertruck show arena seen from a mildly elevated perspective, readable spacious freestyle layout with large dirt tabletop jumps, steel launch ramps, stacked crushable cars, barrel bowling area, wooden crate stacks, and three attractive ring-shaped stunt targets with grounded supports. Compact stands with orange and turquoise seats, perimeter barriers, slender floodlight masts, blank fabric event banners. Exciting but uncluttered routes and generous landing zones. No explosions or danger to people.
Bottom panel WORKSHOP: warmly lit believable repair garage, three-quarter view into a clean spacious truck workshop bay. Central heavy-duty low lifting platform, one turquoise/orange monstertruck parked on it, organized pegboard with tools, orange wheeled tool cabinet, wooden workbench, compact air compressor with coiled hose, real low hydraulic floor jack, spare tires on a rack, large industrial windows and overhead soft strip lights. Truck remains focal, machinery not cluttering its silhouette.
Shared style: believable material response with warm bounce light and cool skylight, glossy body paint but satin rubber and worn steel, tidy bevels, grounded contact shadows, restrained contrast. Contemporary premium stylized racing-game look, NOT crude box blockouts, not abstract low-poly. All panels opaque, no text whatsoever, no watermark, no logos.
